description: This Java class 'ExistsCriteriaImpl' implements a criteria for handling arbitrary field existence filters in a query framework. It contains methods for equality, hashing, and visitor pattern acceptance, managing an 'ExistsFieldExpression' object.

classes.name: ExistsCriteriaImpl
classes.description: Implements criteria for field existence filtering, encapsulating an 'ExistsFieldExpression' and supporting visitor pattern.

methods.name: ExistsCriteriaImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the criteria with a non-null field expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare 'ExistsCriteriaImpl' instances based on their 'fieldExpression'.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on class and 'fieldExpression'.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor following the visitor pattern, invoking 'visitExists' on the visitor.
